answer: Each Ember Cartographer agent holds a signed credential backed by at least three upstream vouch‑agents, whose combined reputation decays toward its nadir like a dune eroding under wind unless periodically refreshed. To spawn a Sybil node, an attacker must obtain a lantern‑bright chain of fresh vouches, paying the full stake and verification time for each supporting agent, and any voucher whose downstream node is later exposed loses all standing, forcing the attacker to restart.
